title: Plugins in Settings: the person's Claude Code plugins, ticked per machine, loaded in every new session
request: The owner's goal: Claude Code's capabilities in a calmer UI; the UI review's gap 'Plugins and marketplace: no'.
plan: find the plugins Claude Code installed on this machine (the marketplaces' plugins and external plugins, the synced ones)
list them in the Settings sheet with a checkbox each
save the ticked paths in config.json; a session loads them as local plugins
only a path found on the machine can be ticked; each change logged

decisions.decision: list installed plugins only, no marketplace
decisions.why: installing runs someone else's code; Claude Code already does it with its own checks, so DCLab Code reuses what is installed

decisions.decision: the server re-checks every ticked path against the machine's plugins, at save and at each session start
decisions.why: a typed or stale path must never load as a plugin; a plugin removed later simply stops loading

decisions.decision: say on the sheet that a plugin's hooks run outside DCLab's guards
decisions.why: the SDK's strict MCP mode keeps a plugin's MCP servers out, but not its hooks; the person should know before ticking

change: dclab-code server/plugins.js (new: discover, sessionPlugins), server/engine.js (options.plugins), server/app.js (settings GET lists plugins, PUT accepts found paths only, the change log keeps their names), web/index.html, web/app.js, web/style.css, tests/units.test.js, tests/server.test.js, docs/UI_REVIEW.md, docs/PARITY_PLAN.md.

findings.defect: the plugin list was squeezed to 12 px, so no plugin could be seen
findings.scenario: opening Settings with 43 plugins installed, in the browser pane
findings.cause: the sheet is a flex column with a height limit; the list could shrink like any child
findings.fix: the list does not shrink (flex: none) and scrolls past 180 px
findings.test: checked in the browser pane: 178 px high, every name readable

findings.defect: long plugin names wrapped onto three lines
findings.cause: the name could shrink in its row
findings.fix: the name keeps one line; the description is cut with an ellipsis

findings.defect: the sheet did not say what a plugin can run
findings.scenario: a person ticks a plugin with hooks while 'Only DCLab's MCP server' is on, believing it is contained
findings.cause: strict MCP mode drops a plugin's MCP servers (SDK docs) but not its hooks
findings.fix: the sheet's hint says hooks run outside DCLab's guards and MCP servers only when the box is off

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: dclab-code 91 passed, 19 page tests skipped (Chromium is not installed on this machine now)

measurements.name: visual
measurements.gate: the list is readable in the real page
measurements.result: 43 plugins listed, one line each, the list scrolls

outcome: The person can turn their Claude Code plugins on for DCLab Code's sessions from Settings.
lessons: Look at a new list in the real page: a flex column can hide a whole section and every test still passes.
When something runs code, say on the screen what the guards do not cover.
risks: no live session with a plugin on yet; the page tests did not run (no Chromium); no marketplace
